caption:
The clay of Costa Rica’s high ridges has a way of slowing down even the strongest riders. When the grade ticks past twenty percent and the afternoon mist rolls in, the line between riding and pushing disappears. It isn’t about speed here; it is about finding a rhythm with the terrain. The clay holds onto your tires, the air gets thin, and the rainforest closes in around you. Up here, luxury isn't a smooth road—it is the silence that remains when you finally reach the top and look back at the valley you just climbed.
